name: Spinach and Provolone Stuffed Flank Steak Rolls
why: Beef roast/steak lane hit: butterflied flank steak rolled around spinach, cream cheese and provolone, seared then oven-baked and sliced into pinwheels - a weigh-and-divide, batch-scalable sliceable roast, not a skillet or braise. Published nutrition 528 cal / 5g carbs / 41g protein lands mid-band on both axes. Flank steak is the signature ingredient and has NO board home (board tracks sirloin-steak and ribeye-steak only), and provolone maps only loosely to generic sliced-cheese - both flagged deliberately to exercise the pricer lane.
confidence: high - nutrition, servings, and full ingredient list read directly from the source page
